instructor_bios.name: Niloofar Montazeri
instructor_bios.title: Assistant Teaching Professor
instructor_bios.bio: Niloofar Montazeri is an Assistant Teaching Professor of Computer Science and Engineering at UC Santa Cruz. She received her PhD in Computer Science from the University of Southern California, where her research focused on Artificial Intelligence and Natural Language Processing. Before joining UC Santa Cruz, she taught computer science for seven years at UC Riverside.
